intuition: Choose each possible palindromic prefix, then partition the remaining suffix recursively.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every cut pattern and test every resulting substring for palindromicity.

optimal.approach: Backtrack over end indices and recurse only when the chosen substring is a palindrome.

edge_cases: An empty string has one partition containing no substrings.
A string of identical characters has a partition at every possible set of cuts.
